reason: In the Saved views menu, Tab from the menu lands on the pencil beside Operating expenses, a focusable div with no role or name. Enter and Space do nothing, so the Rename View dialog never opens and only a mouse click opens it. I found no other keyboard path to rename a view, so a keyboard user cannot rename a saved view.

On both states, Esc closes the Category listbox and focus drops to the page body instead of returning to the combobox. The next Tab resumes after the combobox (Add attachment in the row, Clear combobox selection in the panel), so focus is lost from view and the field is skipped. The rest of the page stays reachable, so the impact is low.

The collapsed money strip is a div with role button and tabindex 0 that holds a focusable Show graphs button, so it still fails 4.1.2. Enter on the strip and Enter on the inner button both expand the graphs, so keyboard and screen-reader users can finish the task; the cost is a duplicate tab stop and a long combined name. Rerated to low.
